scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run bundle
scripts.build:prepared: npm run generate:prepared && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: npm --prefix ../packages/react run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild app.tsx --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/app.js --log-level=warning
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm --prefix ../packages/react run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.generate: (cd .. && lake build Forms.Runtime.Wire Forms.Runtime.Web FormsReact.Component Forms.Protocol.TypeScript) && npm run generate:prepared
